textbookBox.concept: Saving all your money in a cupboard might not be safe, so people deposit it in a bank. Money placed in a bank is called a deposit, and the person or business becomes a bank account holder.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Saving all your money in a cupboard might not be safe, so people deposit it in a bank. Money placed in a bank is called a deposit, and the person or business becomes a bank account holder.
beats.speakEn: Saving all your money in a cupboard might not be safe, so people deposit it in a bank. Money placed in a bank is called a deposit, and the person or business becomes a bank account holder.

beats.en: The bank earns by lending deposits to others. Just as banks pay interest to depositors, they charge interest from borrowers on the loans they provide. Farmers borrow money to start a small business or to expand farming.
beats.speakEn: The bank earns by lending deposits to others. Just as banks pay interest to depositors, they charge interest from borrowers on the loans they provide. Farmers borrow money to start a small business or to expand farming.

textbookBox.concept: At 6 percent a year on Rs 1,000 the interest is Rs 60 in year one. In year two interest is earned on the interest too, giving Rs 63.60, and it keeps growing.

beats.en: At 6 percent a year on Rs 1,000 the interest is Rs 60 in year one. In year two interest is earned on the interest too, giving Rs 63.60, and it keeps growing. This is compounding: money grows on interest earned earlier.
beats.speakEn: At 6 percent a year on Rs 1,000 the interest is Rs 60 in year one. In year two interest is earned on the interest too, giving Rs 63.60, and it keeps growing. This is compounding: money grows on interest earned earlier.

beats.en: With many banks and financial institutions, clear rules are needed. After Independence the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) came under the Government of India and has been the central bank since 1949, the banker of banks.
